title: The / and @ lists above the input
description:
Per the map's Notes (Autocomplete) and the map ticket 'Prototype: the screen updates' (harness-0sx.4); prototype as in Ticket 2.

/ list: typing / with no space yet opens it inline above the input, no box: '› /start-epic    <epic> [--max N]  run every Ticket of an open Epic', the command purple (bold on the cursor row), args muted, the description TEXT on the cursor row and muted otherwise. It filters as you type (contains, else a subsequence), shows up to 8 rows, then a hint line '↑↓ pick · Tab or Enter fills in · Esc clears'. Tab or Enter fills in '<command> '. One command table (name, args, description) holds every command the Shell takes, and nothing else lists them: /start-epic, /start-ticket, /continue, /stop-work, /retry, /park, /address, /questions and /exit now; Tickets 6, 9 and 16 add /summary, /config and /away to it.

@ list: '@<query>' at the end of the input opens the same inline list over open Epics and open Tickets, 'harness-0sx.8  Ticket  <title>', the id in its Epic's or Ticket's color (Ticket 2), ranked: id contains the query, then title contains it, then a subsequence of the id. After /start-epic it lists only Epics; after /start-ticket, /retry, /park or /address only Tickets. Tab or Enter replaces '@<query>' with the id and a space. No list opens by itself in the argument slot (today's Tab completion, Screen::complete, goes); a typed id or query still resolves as today (resolve), a leading @ stripped.

Keys: with a list open ↑↓ move its cursor and Esc clears; otherwise ↑↓ scroll RECENT. Placeholder: '/ for a command, @ for an Epic or Ticket', in Ticket 1's dark orange.

The reasoning behind each decision is on the map's closed tickets: bd show harness-0sx.<n> --json --include-comments. Research notes and prototypes live on local branches: git show research/<name>:docs/research/<file>.md, git show prototype/<name>:<path>. Vocabulary: CONTEXT.md. Decisions: docs/adr/. Rust; crates limited to serde, serde_json, regex, chrono, crossterm, ratatui and ureq, anything else needs a ticket.
acceptance_criteria: Screen tests: '/' lists every command in the table; '/pa' narrows to /park; a subsequence matches when nothing contains the query; Tab fills '/park '; '/start-epic @0s' lists Epics only and Enter fills 'harness-0sx '; '/retry @' lists Tickets only; the ranking order; Esc clears; ↑↓ move the list's cursor while it is open and scroll RECENT when it is not. TestBackend renders of both lists with the hint line and of the placeholder.
